item.title: Trump to Newsmax: Non-Nuclear Mother of All Bombs Option in Iran
item.description: President Donald Trump told Newsmax on Thursday the United States might again strike Iran's nuclear facilities, including the fortified Pickaxe Mountain site.

item.title: Troy Jackson Self-Destructs During Debate at Pivotal Moment in Maine Senate Race
More Damaging Details Surface of Sermon on 'White Privilege' by Kansas Dem Senate Nominee
Personal jabs, billionaire donors and party loyalty fuel heated Maine Senate debate
item.description: Susan Collins and Troy Jackson clashed over political independence and billionaire donors in their fourth Maine Senate debate before the Nov. 3 election.
